description: In an actual forcing context, let \(A\) be countable and predense below \(p\), with \(A^\downarrow\cup\{q:q\perp p\}\) in the context’s ground family. If each \(a\in A\) forces a ground name to have its specified label value, the range of the label function is countable and contains that name’s value under every generic filter through \(p\).
